propositions: Plan-review Pass-2 verification rejects all finding indices as unexpected when zero findings are produced by Pass-1, causing all findings to degrade to INDETERMINATE despite healthy PASS verdict

The root cause is an index-basis mismatch on the request side: verify_instructions() emits 'Emit one verification per finding.' for empty batches, prompting the LLM to return indices [0,1,2,...] against an empty findings list, triggering contract violation

INDETERMINATE findings from Pass-2 degradation cannot cause BLOCK; they are silently absorbed if any advisory finding surfaces, making the failure mode an unverified finding that passes rather than a spurious block

The fix introduces EMPTY_BATCH_INSTRUCTIONS constant to signal empty batches truthfully, preventing index mismatch; identical empty-case bug exists in code_review_verify_inputs and is fixed by the shared kernel seam

Cross-tab of 3908 historical REVIEW_RESULT events shows perfect separation: all 43 violations occurred on zero-finding runs; 2778 multi-finding runs produced no violations, confirming index basis is correct when findings exist
